description: Subsidy up to 15% of capital investment for technology upgrades in manufacturing MSMEs. Applicable for units investing ₹5 lakh or more in new machinery and equipment.
5-year property tax rebate for certified non-polluting manufacturing units. Encourages clean industrial practices with up to 50% tax exemption.
Stamp duty exemption and electricity duty waiver for IT/Services units in designated IT parks across Maharashtra. Valid for first 10 years of operation.
Per-employee monthly subsidy of ₹3,000 for units creating 50+ direct jobs. Available across all sectors for investments exceeding ₹50 lakh.
Capital subsidy of 25% for food processing units investing in cold chain and processing infrastructure. Maximum subsidy of ₹50 lakh.
